project.name: Mood Studio V2
project.description: Hệ thống quản lý Studio áo cưới chuyên nghiệp - Version 2 redesign

tech_stack.api_pattern: Server Actions + Auth HO (withAuth/withAdmin) + Zod + Audit Logs

database_schema.summary: Core: contracts, services, service_categories, printing_orders, labs. Settings: studio_info, employees, notification_preferences, audit_logs.

typography.exceptions: QuoteModernView branding (Watermark) uses hardcoded custom spacing/font weight.

components.ServiceMobileList: Compact row list with active expand state
components.QuoteModal: Compact, floating centered card (max-w 340px) vs V1 parity
components.VisualBuilder: Grid 7/5 Desktop, Single column Mobile, Canvas with GripVertical icons.
components.LayoutStandard: main-container (full-width), detail-grid (12 columns: 8/4 distribution for main/sidebar).
components.PrintingMobileGrouped: Contract-grouped vertical cards (code→name→badges→price) with compact child cards. Pattern synced from ServiceMobileList.
components.PrintingStatsBar: Desktop=6 items, Mobile compact=2 items (total + debt). No click-to-filter (filter pills handle that).

patterns.name: Global List Search Pattern
patterns.details: List modules (Contracts, Printing, CRM) MUST use ONLY the global layout header search (⌘K) which syncs to the '?q=' URL parameter. Do not build inline search inputs inside module filter toolbars. Use the universal `useListFilters` hook configured with `q: ''` defaults.

patterns.name: Explicit Field Selection for Privacy
patterns.details: Always avoid select('*') in server actions that fetch semi-public configuration or profile data to prevent leaking sensitive fields like OAuth tokens or internal metadata.

patterns.name: Ownership Validation in API/Actions
patterns.details: When a resource (e.g., notification) is accessed by ID, always include a filter or validation check against the authenticated user's ID to prevent IDOR vulnerabilities.

patterns.name: Server Actions Separation (Queries vs Mutations)
patterns.details: Read-only actions (settings-queries) employ withAuth/withAdmin but rarely need Zod. Mutating actions (settings-mutations) MUST have strict Zod validation via safeParse, optimistic locking handling, and invoke fireAuditLog immediately upon successful DB operation.

patterns.name: Contract-Grouped Mobile Card Pattern
patterns.details: Printing module groups orders by contract on mobile using vertical cards (service-mobile-list.tsx pattern). Group header: code+chevron → name bold → badge tags → price. Child cards pass compact=true to hide redundant contract info. Expanded section uses subtle bg (bg-bg-subtle/50) with rounded-b-xl.

patterns.name: Compact Stats Bar for Mobile
patterns.details: When a module has both a stats bar AND filter pills showing per-status counts, the stats bar should use compact mode on mobile (show only 2 key metrics). Filter pills already provide status filtering — stats bar click-to-filter is redundant.

gotchas: z.ZodError objects expose an .issues array (not .errors). Use parsed.error.issues[0]?.message for formatting safeParse errors.
employees table often lacks columns present in older V1 schemas (e.g., bank info, salary context). Always verify against current DB schema before coding actions.
Layout Centering Trap: Avoiding max-w-[px] classes on main layout wrappers to maintain consistency with the full-width Gold Standard dashboard.

Mobile Scroll Clipping: Never use `display: none` / `display: flex` purely on CSS for Sidebar duplicating. If sidebar components sit outside the single page scrollable wrapper (like `main-scroll`), they will be completely unviewable on Mobile despite being flex-displayed. The solution is rendering Sidebar elements inline inside the `detail-main` div shielded by an `lg:hidden` wrapper.

Best-Effort External Integrations: Critical infrastructure must securely wrap third-party API executions (e.g., Google Sync). Return standard warnings encoded securely onto standard payloads so explicit feedback can reach the UI unblocked. Do not swallow faults with console exceptions.

RBAC Validation Updates: Client-driven identifier inputs present massive risks during state mutation. Updates applied on records must universally cross-check ownership over target entity ID equivalents BEFORE writing modifications.
